# `fnox plugin install`

- **Usage:** `fnox plugin install [-f --force] [NAME] [SOURCE]`

Install plugins from git

With no arguments, installs every plugin declared under `[plugins]` that is not installed yet. A source is a git URL, optionally followed by `#<ref>` to pin a tag, branch, or commit; `owner/repo` is shorthand for GitHub.

## Arguments

- **`[NAME]`** — Plugin name; installs all declared plugins when omitted
- **`[SOURCE]`** — Git source; defaults to the name's entry under `[plugins]`

## Flags

- **`-f --force`** — Reinstall even if the plugin is already installed
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

Examples:
fnox plugin install
fnox plugin install corp
fnox plugin install corp acme/fnox-plugin-corp#v1.0.0
fnox plugin install corp https://git.example.com/fnox-plugin-corp.git

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Clones a plugin from git into the plugins directory. Without arguments, installs every plugin declared under [plugins]. A source may pin a tag, branch, or commit with `#<ref>`; `owner/repo` is shorthand for GitHub.

```sh
fnox plugin install
fnox plugin install corp acme/fnox-plugin-corp#v1.2.0
```
